author: Inside Edition
description: A group of tourists found themselves trapped in an elevator in Las Vegas. Melissa Elicio, a nurse from Arizona, was one of the 17 tourists and documented the ordeal. She says there were only four people in the elevator when she got on and as it descended to the lobby, more and more people got on. Security at the Rio Hotel assured them that help was on the way. After 55 minutes, they were rescued by firefighters. The Rio Hotel did not respond to Inside Edition's request for comment.
title: 17 Tourists Trapped In Elevator For 55 Minutes Before Getting Freed

author: Inside Edition
description: Princess Kate received a warm welcome as she arrived in Italy for her first solo trip abroad since her cancer diagnosis. She greeted well-wishers and posed for selfies. The princess has been slowly returning to royal duties since finishing "preventative chemotherapy" in 2014. Inside Edition spoke with Christopher Andersen, bestselling author of the new book "Kate: The Courage, Grace, and Power of the Woman Who Will Be Queen."
title: Princess Kate Takes 1st Solo Trip Abroad Since Cancer Diagnosis

author: Inside Edition
description: The children's book author who poisoned her husband learned her fate Wednesday. Kouri Richins watched and made faces during her former sister-in-law's testimony. She also appeared to be rolling her eyes during a statement from another sister-in-law. The real estate agent was convicted in March of murdering her husband Eric at their Utah home by spiking his cocktail with fentanyl. A year after Eric Richins' murder, the mother-of-three wrote a children's book about dealing with grief and promoted it on a local tv station.
title: Kouri Richins Sentenced To Life Without Parole For Poisoning Husband

author: Inside Edition
description:
Sponsored Content by RoC Skincare.

Inside Edition teamed up with RoC® Skincare and its paid partner, dermatologist Dr. Sheila Farhang, for tips to brighten dark circles around the eyes. She says one solution is laser treatment, but it can be expensive and may not address all types of dark circles. Dr. Farhang recommends RoC's new Eye Repair Cream as an at-home non-invasive solution to help reverse the look of stubborn dark circles.
title: Dermatologist's Tip To Help Brighten Stubborn Dark Circles Around The Eyes

author: Inside Edition
description: A police officer goes into a burning home after learning there's a family inside. The Chattanooga Police Department released this bodycam video showing the officer run up to the front door and past the flames to get people out. At first he carried out a child and handed him off to someone outside, then he went back for the others. When everyone was out, the officer came back with a fire extinguisher. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Cop Rescues 2 Kids And Mom From House Fire

author: Inside Edition
description: A group of burglars dubbed the "Bear Spray Gang" broke into a home in Studio City, California. Brave neighbor Steve Calabro ran outside to confront the burglars before getting hit with bear spray. A GoFundMe has been set up to help Calabro save his home. For more information, you can click this link: https://www.gofundme.com/f/save-steves-home-after-his-heroic-act
title: Burglars Armed With Bear Spray Are Breaking Into Homes #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: This little stowaway had her family in a panic when she slipped away from them and boarded a bus. It happened in Turkey. Reports say the child's family was at a nearby phone store when she went out exploring. She saw the open door on this empty bus and decided to hitch a ride. The driver didn't see her, because he reportedly stepped off the bus to buy some bread. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: 2-Year-Old Girl Returned To Family After Sneaking Onto Empty Bus
